nodes.label: L0 database-only recovery
nodes.rationale: RTO 4h; estimated 1h-1h50m; restore itself is seconds, time is provisioning and reconfiguration. Auth data is not restored.

nodes.label: Restore privilege pre-step and auth shim
nodes.norm_label: restore privilege pre-step and auth shim
nodes.rationale: ACLs name roles that must exist; default privileges must be revoked from anon/authenticated before restore so tables aren't readable before their ACLs apply.

nodes.label: age encryption, public key only in CI
nodes.norm_label: age encryption, public key only in ci
nodes.rationale: Compromising the ops repo lets an attacker write an unreadable backup, not read one.

nodes.label: Auth path B: public schema only
nodes.norm_label: auth path b: public schema only
nodes.rationale: No auth.* data or privileged grants; carts and profiles schema-only because they hold live customer PII/session state.

nodes.label: age private key never leaves owner control
nodes.norm_label: age private key never leaves owner control
nodes.rationale: Every tool takes a path; never in CI, chat, cloud folders, or logged commands. Losing it makes every backup permanently unrecoverable.

nodes.label: Three-copy key custody with escrow
nodes.rationale: Three survives a loss plus an inaccessible location; escrow holds the key only, separated from repo access. Second ops-repo admin keeps artifacts reachable.

nodes.label: AVIF feasibility: rejected for now
nodes.rationale: 36% saving but +18 MB repo and needs <picture>; Cloudinary f_auto already serves AVIF

nodes.label: Backup destination comparison (private repo chosen)
nodes.rationale: public repo artifacts rejected; R2 requires payment method

nodes.label: Migration ledger gap
nodes.rationale: Dump is --schema=public so supabase_migrations is absent; manifest now records the ledger so it can be rebuilt to 001-029. Stopping at 029 is deliberate because 032 was applied by hand and left unrecorded.

nodes.label: Production apply routes (run-migrations.mjs, db query --linked, SQL Editor + repair)
nodes.norm_label: production apply routes (run-migrations.mjs, db query --linked, sql editor + repair)
nodes.rationale: Applied only when the owner asks; /admin/database one-click apply disabled (e7cdb19). Migration and ledger row commit together under advisory lock 746392018.

nodes.label: backup_reader rotation and revocation
nodes.rationale: Set secrets via gh prompt so values never reach shell history; revoke with nologin first before removing data access.

nodes.label: Expand, then contract
nodes.rationale: An application rollback does not roll the database back, so previously deployed code must keep working on the new schema.

nodes.label: Never first on production
nodes.rationale: Test on ingest-eval replay harness or supabase db reset first; verify-p0.mjs is stale and not a gate.

nodes.label: Apply 030->031->032->033 as a set
nodes.rationale: 030 is not backward-compatible with the 029-era worker (review states, unfrozen batches, duplicated photos), and applyMigrations refuses a ledger gap, so code ships first then all four apply in order. Applied 2026-10-12.

nodes.label: Dependabot grouped weekly upgrades
nodes.rationale: Majors ignored on purpose; they get their own branch and deploy alone so rollback is one revert.

nodes.label: npm audit --omit=dev CI gate
nodes.rationale: Dev-only vulnerabilities are build-time; fix with majors, not npm audit fix --force. tailwindcss-animate moved to devDependencies.

nodes.label: Required check 'Lint, types, unit tests, build'
nodes.norm_label: required check 'lint, types, unit tests, build'
nodes.rationale: Referenced by exact job name; renaming the job in ci.yml silently breaks the required check.

nodes.label: ESLint flat config over Biome
nodes.rationale: Next-specific rules are the valuable part; Biome lacks them. Migrate with the Next 16 upgrade.

nodes.label: Option B: branch protection on main with owner bypass
nodes.norm_label: option b: branch protection on main with owner bypass
nodes.rationale: Vercel deploys on every push without waiting for CI; the rule stops unreviewed contributor changes with red CI while keeping the owner's commit+push redeploy flow.

nodes.label: IndexNow manual submission
nodes.rationale: File-driven catalog has no publish action to hook an automatic trigger into.

nodes.label: "Nothing is invented" rule
nodes.rationale: Client supplied no verified weave/fibre/region/price; catalogue browsed by colour.

nodes.label: Textile Collection Pages (Banarasi, Bandhej)
nodes.rationale: Only textile types with enough real inventory to avoid thin content.

nodes.label: Anthropic Console spend limit (hard cap)
nodes.rationale: App caps are software and can have bugs; the provider spend limit is the only hard cap, so it must be set. Default workspace cannot be limited, so the key lives in a dedicated wcs-storefront workspace.

nodes.label: Per-feature daily AI caps (ai_usage_daily)
nodes.rationale: Reserved atomically before a request; listing/metadata/collection/color_variants 200 per UTC day by default (AI_DAILY_CAP_<FEATURE>).

nodes.label: Spend-limit pause until next month
nodes.rationale: Anthropic's spend-limit responses mean retrying before the 1st of next month fails anyway, so AI is paused and no retries are made after any error.

nodes.label: Free-tier hard caps per provider
nodes.rationale: Everything stops at its free limit except Anthropic (spend limit must be set) and GitHub (no payment method must stay on file).

nodes.label: Restore drill (scripts/restore-drill.mjs)
nodes.rationale: Run quarterly on an artifact at least a day old; verifies against the bundle manifest, shreds plaintext and drops the DB in a finally block. Passed 16/16 on 2026-10-12.

nodes.label: Not in 033: default-grant revokes, leaked password protection, edge functions
nodes.norm_label: not in 033: default-grant revokes, leaked password protection, edge functions
nodes.rationale: Twelve service-role tables still carry default anon grants protected by RLS-with-no-policy alone; revoking is defence in depth left for its own migration.

nodes.label: RLS, not grants, is the control
nodes.norm_label: rls, not grants, is the control
nodes.rationale: anon holds ALL on 22 of 26 tables; inquiries is protected only by RLS with no SELECT policy, so the drill checks RLS state, policy counts and actual row counts.

nodes.label: pg_dump flag set (custom format, no --no-privileges)
nodes.rationale: Grants/revokes in migrations are the security posture; a dump without privileges would restore a DB handing anon more than production does.

nodes.label: Personal data flows to third parties
nodes.norm_label: personal data flows to third parties
nodes.rationale: Sentry beforeSend redaction, logger redaction, analytics param allowlist, Clarity strict masking, Anthropic gets no customer data.

nodes.label: Deleting one person's data
nodes.rationale: Delete by normalised phone; backups are not edited but age out within 56 days, so a restore in that window must repeat the deletion.

nodes.label: Yearly age key rotation
nodes.rationale: Keep old key until every live artifact post-dates rotation (max 56 days); age -d accepts multiple identities.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions artifact retention (14 daily + 8 Sunday)
nodes.norm_label: github actions artifact retention (14 daily + 8 sunday)
nodes.rationale: Artifacts expire on their own and cannot be rewritten by force-push; ~2.2% of the 500 MB quota. No payment method is the spend cap.

nodes.label: CartContext (wcs.cart.v2, synchronous persist)
nodes.rationale: Debounce dropped writes on unmount.

nodes.label: reconcileOnSignIn cart reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Unguarded merge doubled the cart on every refresh.

nodes.label: storefront_hidden_slugs view hardening
nodes.rationale: Keeps security_invoker=off because invoker mode would return zero rows to anon, un-hiding every admin-hidden product; writes closed by 032 revokes and non-auto-updatable view.

nodes.label: AI ledger fail-closed
nodes.rationale: If the ledger cannot be read no AI call is made; a refusal loses nothing because deterministic fallbacks exist and AI never publishes.

nodes.label: Backup alerts and freshness (T1.11)
nodes.rationale: Sentry Cron heartbeat, freshness.yml (30h staleness, artifact quota), cleanup job (14 daily + 8 Sunday).

nodes.label: L1 full application recovery
nodes.rationale: Env vars, DNS, Auth, WhatsApp, Upstash, Resend, Sentry, GitHub, cron; DNS propagation is the only item that can exceed one working day.

nodes.label: Keep-alive decision (no extra job)
nodes.rationale: Daily whatsapp sweep cron and the backup pg_dump already produce database activity, preventing Supabase Free pausing.
